required_inputs: committed source SHA and source-archive SHA-256
exact BIN SHA-256 and byte size
Arm compiler, linker, objcopy and CMake identity
link map and exact first-party compiled source inventory
pinned STM32CubeL4 gitlink revision and consumed vendor source inventory
FreeRTOS kernel and CM4F port provenance and consumed source inventory
license identifiers, evidence references and redistribution review
generation_mode: explicit opt-in against an existing Pandora RTOS build directory
next_gate: Review generated source/vendor inventories and complete full-scope license/legal inputs before any release qualification decision.
evidence_boundary: This policy and its opt-in generator establish a bounded CycloneDX record from the current build map and linked archives. They do not establish complete MCU dependency coverage, legal approval, security approval, runtime qualification, or R1 remains blocked.
